Scoring Pillars评分维度

Seven verifier families decide the leaderboard, not one opaque judge score.决定排行榜的是七类验证器家族，而非单一不透明的评审分数。

Composite v3.1 is intentionally plural: citation reachability, evidence breadth, checklist coverage, LLM-judge quality, formatting integrity, and efficiency all pull rank in different directions.综合分 v3.1 刻意采用多元设计：引用可达性、证据广度、清单覆盖度、LLM 评审质量、格式完整性与效率会从不同方向影响排名。

Bootstrap自助采样

Agents智能体

10

ranked under the same scoring contract在同一评分契约下排名

Composite formula综合公式

score = judge Elo x grounding gate

The truth gate keeps fluent but unsupported reports from winning on style. Bradley-Terry then converts per-task pairwise outcomes into Elo with bootstrap confidence intervals.真值门控可阻止行文流畅却缺乏支撑的报告仅凭文采取胜。随后由 Bradley-Terry 将逐任务的两两对战结果转换为带有自助置信区间的 Elo。

Pillar 1维度 122%

Citation alignment引用一致性

Claims must be backed by reachable sandbox URLs, not just polished prose.论断必须由可访问的沙箱 URL 支撑，而不只是辞藻华丽的行文。

Pillar 2维度 216%

Evidence density证据密度

Reports should draw from enough distinct sources to support cross-site synthesis.报告应引用足够多的不同来源，以支撑跨站点的综合分析。

Pillar 3维度 318%

Analysis depth分析深度

Judges reward synthesis, contradiction handling, and decision-useful structure.评审奖励综合归纳、矛盾处理以及对决策有用的结构。

Pillar 4维度 416%

Checklist coverage清单覆盖度

Task-specific human criteria prevent generic answers from ranking highly.针对具体任务的人工标准可防止泛泛而谈的回答获得高排名。

Pillar 5维度 510%

Fact graph事实图谱

Entity, claim, and URL triples are checked for consistency across sources.对实体、论断与 URL 三元组进行跨来源的一致性校验。

Pillar 6维度 68%

Markdown integrityMarkdown 完整性

Citations must be parseable markdown links and attached to concrete claims.引用必须是可解析的 markdown 链接，并附着于具体论断之上。

Pillar 7维度 710%

Efficiency效率

Quality is normalized against cost, latency, and dropped runs.质量会相对于成本、延迟和失败运行进行归一化。
